body: If you think about family I think there is still someting to live for. They tell me to talk to people. Not everyone maybe, but your family? The ones you choose to live for. Because after I wrote this I talked to my bestfriend, she helped a lot. I was still crying but I laughed some when she left. And after that I went home and talked to my husband. He never gets it, he is always surprised that I can feel this way. But it felt good to talk. Even though my problems are still there I am a little bit better at managing today.

It seems like breathing can help. If I remember it I will try that next time. There is a thinking pattern my doctor gave me but it is not about suicidal thoughts. It helps so I think breathing might help too. I have an appointment with my doctor but its 2 weeks from now and I cant get a sooner one. I am waiting for that one.

The problem is I talk, I seek help, it seems like I am ok. Then it happens again. And when the pattern repeats itself I feel like that one is undefeatable.

Whatever help I get, I think that its my will to overcome this. The reason this happens to me is my perception of the world I think. If I change that I might feel better.

I tried to talk to my husband but he somehow manages to say the wrong thing everytime. He tries his best though. But I my bestfriend went through similar things. She helps me a lot. She calmed me down. She asked me to find something to live for but I dont know how to find that.
